3129-4050-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-4050-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7156.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

413-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-6441-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

772-4050-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
772-4050-6553.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

908-1432--80.easyPrerequisites:
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness
Norritt does not have summoning sickness.
908-1432--80.notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Norritt do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
908-1432--80.description:
If Norritt is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Norritt to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Norritt and another legendary creature.
Activate Norritt's first ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.

5223-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
5223-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

3259-5223-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5223-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

186-962-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Yurlok of Scorch Thrash.
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
186-962-2816.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {2} and untapping it, causing itself to get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large amount of times.
Move to your next step or phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the amount of unspent mana in their mana pool.
Each player whose mana pool contained an amount of mana equal to or greater than their life total loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1267-2886-5406.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Medomai the Ageless exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
1267-2886-5406.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {0} if it's the first equip ability you've activated this turn, or {2} otherwise, attaching it to the attacking creature, and causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using the creature.
The creature triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Repeat each turn.

1584-2430-2670-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four experience counters.
1584-2430-2670-3075.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {U}, and choosing to pay an additional {U} and reveal Psychic Puppetry from your hand, adding Psychic Puppetry's effects to Petals of Insight.
Resolve Petals of Insight, looking at the top three cards of your library, putting them on the bottom of your library, untapping Teferi's Isle, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Repeat.

233-575-714-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
233-575-714-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Swamp creature due to Kormus Bell and Urborg.
Repeat.

2512-2603-4943.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lancers en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Lancers en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

1981-2899-4378.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have a way to cause the additional creature to die.
1981-2899-4378.description:
Cause the additional creature to die.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain one life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield as a 0/0 due to Kaervek and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

1379-3734-4375-5119.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nonland permanent.
An additional creature with mana value 2 or less in graveyard.
At least three loyalty counters on Daretti.
1379-3734-4375-5119.description:
Activate Daretti's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from them, sacrificing any other nonland permanent and returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Technomancer enters the battlefield, milling three cards and returning Phyrexian Metamorph and any creature cards with total mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Metamorph enters the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Put the original Daretti in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, sacrificing Technomancer and returning Daretti from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Daretti's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from them, sacrificing one of the creatures returned in step 2 and returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

539-3512-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-3512-4657.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Mana Flare triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
